messages.text: Merged PR #234. Auth middleware refactoring complete.
For the microservice migration, I think Event Sourcing pattern would work well.
This has an N+1 query issue. Using QueryBuilder with JOIN should improve performance.
Fixed the deployment pipeline error. It was a Docker build cache issue — resolved with multi-stage build.
Sharing this sprint's retrospective results. API response time improved by 30%.
